Q: How to match noisy GPS data to a known route? A:

Finding nearest points is not a problem. You can either use scipy cKDTree for quick calculation, or some geopandas/shapely methods like shapely.ops.nearest_points. The real problem is to maintain consitency, especially when you have a complicated route with loops and self-intersections. I would resample the known rout data to neglect positioning bias, find distance between points and apply constraints.

Q: Round to 5 (or other number) in Python A:

We can generalize and go:

def myround(x, base=5):
    return base * round(float(x) / base)

This allows us to use non-integer bases, like .25 or any other fractional base.

Q: Keycloak custom theme messages encoding and russian localization A:

IMPORTANT IF YOU CAME AFTER MANY YEARS WITH NO SOLUTIOON

As mentioned above, Keycloak starting from v23 handles UTF8.
BUT the editor may force use the ISO-8859-1. I use PHPStorm and it had a default ISO-8859-1 for .properties files.

So, if you have a "?" in your translation files but newer version of KC, simply do this:

Enable UTF-8 for .properties files in PhpStorm

  1. Go to:
    File -> Settings -> Editor -> File Encodings

  2. Look for the section Properties files:

    • Default encoding for properties files -> set to UTF-8

    • Transparent native-to-ascii conversion -> uncheck this

      • This is important - otherwise PhpStorm will convert all non-ASCII characters to \uXXXX automatically.

  3. Click Apply -> OK.

Q: Cloudflare is redirecting my request from HTTPS to HTTP A:

This is an old thread, but I was experiencing it just now. Same problem, but everything was set up properly in the FE. Turns out that my FastAPI backend was creating these 307s and the http:// redirects. The solution for me was adding this in my app/main.py.

# Proxy headers middleware - MUST be first to correctly handle X-Forwarded-* headers from reverse proxy
# This fixes HTTPS redirects when behind a proxy (Render, Cloudflare, etc.)
app.add_middleware(ProxyHeadersMiddleware, trusted_hosts="*")

Q: Insert/Override caret mode in IntelliJ IDEA on macOS A:

You can use the Toggle Insert/Overwrite action by searching for it with Help | Find Action. If you type Alt+Enter on the Find Action search result, you can assign a keyboard shortcut to it.
